answer: Identity leases make sybil hoarding expire. First, every identity rents its status for 12 epochs at 80 units. Then, renewal needs proof of real work in at least 9 of those 12 epochs; a tide of idle leases simply lapses. Finally, lapsed identities lose their history and pay full price again, while a ferrous audit trail blocks re-registration under a recycled credential. Forgery ends a lease at once and forfeits the remaining rent. Cost math: 1,000 clones pay 80,000 units per cycle, and a garden of dormant identities must be replanted every 12 epochs at full price.
